status: WORKING COMPARISON — one continuous suspended RC pour with conditional mineral DPC and air boundary

HAD.role: Current Reference House geometry and authored D1800 grade comparison.

STRfloor.role: Located structural pour, coverage, mass and crack comparisons.

STRgrid.role: Proposed common grid and foundation heads with actual comparison axes and depths.

RWTlowerTrack.role: Unadopted upper-first mechanism, including motion and the lowered rail through the inhabited gallery. Retain the selected HAD track as a separate comparison.

STRtoe.role: Stair bearing axis and explicit unresolved thermal toe contact.

field.role: Retained field layout, 22 wall bases, three RC crossings and actual external door cuts.

ordinaryWall.role: Proposed bonded mineral DPC and ordinary wall/floor air transition.

ordinaryOuter.role: Ordinary 429.5 mm wall layer order only. The historic local pier, floor and lower cold receiver are excluded.

loggia.role: Earlier located loggia wall-base tray comparison only. Current depths, plan, grid and site comparator come from HAD and STR.

airDuty.role: Single provisional floor/wall aggregate, with disjoint opening and service families.

court.role: Shared conditional court assembly at the opening-family cut.

moistureGuidance.edition: England AD C, 2004 with 2010/2013 amendments, printed p27 §§4.17–4.20 and §5.5. Accessed 7 November 2026.
moistureGuidance.role: Suspended-floor moisture control and separate drainage/ventilation conditions. Site gas, groundwater, actual materials and project applicability remain open.

ventSliceTrial.role: Two opposed W/E geometric strips under the proposed common grid. The 50% fraction is an authored removable-screen requirement for comparison. No product, formed plinth opening, exposure or every-bay circulation is assumed.

ventMouth.role: Authored removable metal screen and hood with continuous cheeks and a free outer drip. All dimensions are clear finished geometry except the named skirt thickness. No proprietary product, weather test or installed plinth is credited.

ventCrossing.role: Geometric air corridor in the open void, with local space to drop and rise on either side of the water track. The westward solum fall is a sensitivity for the pre-site drainage requirement, with no nominated construction or outfall.

binderEvidence.product: Cemex Portland, Rugby works, CEM I 52.5 N
binderEvidence.role: Issue 13 dated 10 March 2026 identifies Rugby CEM I and its DoP. Manufacturer EPD composition table excludes gypsum and identifies significant heat of hydration. Exact batch, minor additions, processing aids and delivered concrete remain unqualified.

mixTrial.role: Authored absolute-volume comparison for washed mineral aggregate and effective water, without a credited admixture. Densities, void fraction, delivered workability/strength and retained constituents require evidence.

curingAndJoint.candidate: One continuous upper lift after lower grid preparation. Plan temporary formwork removal, batch continuity and water curing with recoverable protection.
releaseDuties: Record actual batch yield, temperature, effective water, consolidation and cover.
Protect exposed concrete promptly against moisture loss, rain washing and temperature extremes. Verify curing and early-age restraint for the actual binder and placement.
Treat a full-depth interruption seam as a new joint with its own load, capillary, water and air route.
Expose and assess the cured slab, wall-base junctions and openings interfaces before covering with glass and the service/finish layers.

airScreen.role: Ideal full-depth uniform smooth slit sensitivity with no slip, laminar fully developed flow. Actual through-crack length, aperture profile, contact, entry/end effects, site gas and installed air/moisture are unmeasured.
